article.title: 때문에 por causa de
article.part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태

claims.summary: The NIKL guide compares **-기 때문에** with **-(으)므로**: both give a reason or basis, but they differ in register and in whether a following command or proposal is licensed. This entry is limited to those documented differences and does not repeat the separate noun + 때문에 lesson.
